module_summary: AXI-stream rate limiter: an accumulator credits rate_denom-rate_num per beat and deasserts input ready (optionally at frame boundaries), feeding a registered skid-buffer output.

anchors.name: acc_reg
anchors.why: Rate accumulator: adds denom-num per accepted beat, drains by num per cycle; drives pause.

anchors.name: pause
anchors.why: Throttle flag from accumulator threshold; blocks next-cycle input ready.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: In-frame flag so pausing waits for frame boundary when rate_by_frame.

anchors.name: rate_num
anchors.why: Rate numerator: accumulator threshold and per-beat subtraction.

anchors.name: rate_denom
anchors.why: Rate denominator added to accumulator per accepted beat.

anchors.name: rate_by_frame
anchors.why: Mode: pause only between frames instead of any beat.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input stream payload passed into the output register path.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input valid; with tready accepts a beat and updates accumulator.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Registered input ready, low while paused or output full.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling output/temp register transfers.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready deciding store to output or temp register.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_early
anchors.why: Early internal ready: output ready or temp slot free; feeds input ready.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer payload held when output is stalled.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer occupied flag; gates early ready.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable: input beat to output registers.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Load enable: input beat into skid registers.

anchors.name: store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable: skid registers to output registers.

groups.name: Rate accumulator
groups.description: Token-style accumulator deciding when to pause input.

groups.name: Input handshake
groups.description: Registered input ready and internal beat signals.

groups.name: Skid output register
groups.description: Output register plus temp skid register with transfer enables.
